message.content:
Below is a concise list of the long‑weekend holidays that occur in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a statutory holiday that falls on a Monday or a Friday (or is observed on a Monday when it falls on a weekend).  The table shows the holiday, the date it falls on in 2023, the province(s) where it applies, and the resulting long‑weekend period.

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Province(s) | Long‑Weekend Period |
|-------------|---------|-------------|---------------------|
| **Jan 1 (Thu)** | New Year’s Day (observed Mon Jan 2) | All provinces | Sat Dec 31 – Mon Jan 2 |
| **Feb 20 (Mon)** | Family Day | Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia | Sat Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20 |
| **Mar 31 (Fri)** | Good Friday | All provinces | Fri Mar 31 – Sun Apr 2 |
| **May 22 (Mon)** | Victoria Day | All provinces | Sat May 20 – Mon May 22 |
| **Jul 1 (Tue)** | Canada Day (observed Mon Jul 3) | All provinces | Sat Jun 30 – Mon Jul 3 |
| **Sep 4 (Mon)** | Labour Day | All provinces | Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4 |
| **Oct 9 (Mon)** | Thanksgiving | All provinces | Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9 |
| **Nov 11 (Fri)** | Remembrance Day (observed Mon Nov 13 in some provinces) | Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland & Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, Saskatchewan | Fri Nov 11 – Sun Nov 13 (or Sat Nov 12 – Mon Nov 13 in provinces that observe it on Monday) |
| **Dec 25 (Mon)** | Christmas Day | All provinces | Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25 |
| **Dec 26 (Tue)** | Boxing Day (observed Mon Dec 27 in some provinces) | Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland & Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, Saskatchewan | Tue Dec 26 – Thu Dec 28 (or Mon Dec 27 – Wed Dec 29 in provinces that observe it on Monday) |

### Notes

1. **Observance on Mondays** – When a holiday falls on a weekend, most provinces observe it on the following Monday.  The table reflects the observed date where applicable (e.g., New Year’s Day, Canada Day, Remembrance Day, Boxing Day).

2. **Provincial Variations** –  
   * **Remembrance Day** is observed on Monday in most provinces, but in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland & Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, and Saskatchewan it is observed on the actual Friday, 11 Nov.  
   * **Boxing Day** is observed on Monday in the same set of provinces listed above.

3. **Other Provincial Holidays** – Some provinces have additional statutory holidays that also create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.).  Those are not included here because they are not nationwide.

Feel free to integrate this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you need the full list of all statutory holidays (including those that do not create long weekends) or a province‑specific breakdown, let me know!
